scope: Initial normal viewer login frame with pinned loopback browser content; offline production world replay is a separate required R0 witness.
random_seed_scope: Seeded ObjectUpdate block arrival order in the separate production-world fixture; no global RNG override.
clock_scope: Live startup/service clock; the offline world fixture fixes render epoch, elapsed time, frame and zero motion delta, restoring them before service work.

comparison.policy: Preserve every mismatch; cross-backend failure is a tracked parity gap, not permission to update goldens. Unstable repeated captures fail baseline repeatability.

metrics.pre_render_cpu_ms: Main frame entry to UI render entry; includes services, idle and prior world GL work, so it is not a comparable isolated service metric.
metrics.render_submit_cpu_ms: UI/native render entry to readback entry; excludes capture wait/I/O. OpenGL and Vulkan stage contents differ and must not be compared as identical GPU workloads.
metrics.capture_wait_and_io_ms: Synchronization/readback/write overhead, excluded from renderer FPS claims.
metrics.observed_total_frame_cpu_ms: Observed frame including capture overhead; not steady-state FPS.
metrics.presentation_cpu_ms: Actual swap/present call after synchronized capture; not unperturbed frame pacing.
metrics.initial_scene_decode_cpu_ms: One-time actual ObjectUpdate consumer cost, retained separately from steady frames.
metrics.fixture_service_poll_cpu_ms: Loopback UDP and ACK polling cost; not a claim that all connected services are exercised.
metrics.packet_build_cpu_ms: Native scene packet generation or reference stateSort/postSort; stage contents differ and topology must be considered.
metrics.geometry_update_cpu_ms: Reference production geometry update pass; initial rebuilds occur during warmup.
metrics.scene_update_cpu_ms: Reference object idle/update pass with stationary primitives.
metrics.draw_upload_binding_counters: Actual render-thread LLVertexBuffer draw/upload/bind events on GL; actual native mesh/constant uploads, draws and descriptor allocations/commits. API-specific counts are not identical operations.
metrics.skinning: The first static corpus has zero avatars. Record zero workload explicitly; it does not measure animated-avatar performance.
metrics.gpu_ms: Unavailable until production timestamp queries are implemented; never substitute zero or CPU duration.
metrics.statistics: Five samples are a capture sanity baseline, not a sustained performance benchmark. Report count, median, p95 and maximum; no physical-GPU FPS claim.

required_r0_witnesses: source inventory with explicit feature dispositions
two independent software OpenGL/Vulkan production viewer runs
repeated scene images and mismatch report

world_fixture_oracle.projected_regions: Red in right half, green in left half; middle vertical third.
world_fixture_oracle.tint_identity: Dominant channel at least 40, greater than 1.25 times the other object color channel and more than 8 above blue. Allows reference color transforms; does not relax exact peer/repeatability comparisons.

login_page_fixture.title: Vulkanstorm parity login fixture v1
login_page_fixture.scope: Loopback-only static page through the shared ForceLoginURL setting and actual CEF media path; paint readiness precedes five unmasked consecutive captures.
